name: nebulate
description: Local YouTube and Nebula matching browser extension

scripts.lint: biome check extension/entrypoints extension/core test/modern wxt.config.ts vitest.config.ts scripts/check-artifacts.mjs scripts/update-creators.ts
scripts.format: biome check --write extension/entrypoints extension/core test/modern wxt.config.ts vitest.config.ts scripts/check-artifacts.mjs scripts/update-creators.ts
scripts.check: bun run --no-env-file lint && bun run --no-env-file typecheck && bun run --no-env-file test && bun run --no-env-file build:chrome && bun run --no-env-file build:firefox && node scripts/check-artifacts.mjs
